sourceWorks.title: Fallout
sourceWorks.description: The original 1997 role-playing game follows a Vault 13 resident through the settlements of southern California and into conflict with the Unity.

sourceWorks.title: Fallout 2
sourceWorks.description: The 1998 sequel follows the Chosen One through a later California shaped by the first game's people, settlements and conditional history.

sourceWorks.title: Fallout 3
sourceWorks.description: The 2008 game explores the Capital Wasteland and an eastern Brotherhood presence; its archive index remains a prototype layer.

sourceWorks.title: Fallout: New Vegas
sourceWorks.description: The 2010 game centres on the Mojave and the struggle surrounding Hoover Dam; current records form a representative cluster.

sourceWorks.title: Fallout 4
sourceWorks.description: The 2015 game explores the Commonwealth and later institutional histories; selected cross-franchise evidence is indexed.

sourceWorks.title: Fallout 76
sourceWorks.description: The 2018 game supplies early post-War records, including substantial evidence about Roger Maxson and the first Brotherhood network.
